name: Manbiki Musume ni Seisai o 2
source:
Girls who like to grab things that don't belong to them are punished in kind...!

Hinata the poverty-stricken maid is gangbanged by guys at the department store who see her stealing. 
Popular TV anchor Tomoka is a shoplifter just for the thrill of it. The middle aged man who knows this... 
Azusa the teenage model was spotted stealing by a perverted lady at the shop that stalked her home.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ126444.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
喜欢拿走不属于自己东西的女孩，会受到相应的惩罚……！

贫困女仆日向在百货公司偷窃，被发现后遭一群男人轮奸。人气电视主播友香只是为了寻求刺激才去偷东西。一个知道内情的中年男人……

年轻模特Azusa在商店行窃时，被一名跟踪她回家的变态女人撞见。[引自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ126444.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
